title: Horizon Verify verdict report
description: HO-841: the 200 response of GET /api/admin/productivity/verify. The first `n` Tasks closed strictly after `since` (from its 00:00:00 UTC), in close order, each with its newest Verify & report outcome and, when Execute failed, its cause. One file feeds the route's serializer, the published OpenAPI spec and the contract test. IDs, times and enums only: no summary, log line or evidence text. Every object lists all its keys in required and forbids extras.

since.description: The requested start day, YYYY-MM-DD, echoed back. Tasks closed at or before its 00:00:00 UTC are not counted.

n.description: The requested number of Tasks, echoed back.

project.description: The requested project id, or 'all', echoed back.

returned.description: How many Tasks are listed: n, or fewer when fewer have closed since.

tasks.description: The cohort, in close order; Tasks closed at the same second are ordered by id.

closedAt.description: The Task's close, as stored (UTC, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS').

verdict.description: The Task's newest done Verify & report outcome. A run from before HO-841 stored as 'fail' reads 'work_failed'. null when no Verify run recorded a verdict.

executeCause.description: Why Execute failed: 'prereq' for a missing tool, secret, file or precondition the plan could have checked; 'unforeseeable' for anything else. Only on a 'work_failed' verdict whose Execute run failed; null otherwise, and on every run from before HO-841.

verdicts.description: Tasks per verdict; 'none' counts Tasks with no recorded Verify verdict.

executeCauses.description: Tasks per Execute cause. A 'work_failed' Task with no cause is in neither.

prereqShare.description: prereq / (prereq + unforeseeable), to 4 places: the share of caused Execute failures that were unmet prerequisites. null when no Task in the cohort has a cause.

firstPassYield.description: rework().firstPassYield over exactly the listed Tasks: the share closed with no send-back and no failed automated review, to 4 places, 0 for an empty cohort. Task cohort only — not the Productivity dashboard's figure, which covers every item kind closed in a time window, so the two can differ.
